title: Two lines of work
brief: main moved ahead with app work while the feature branch added notes on its own line of history. Two branches, two commits, one base. Bring the feature work into main.

goals.label: A merge commit joins feature into main
Four commits reachable: base, both lines of work, the merge

diagnostics.say: You are on feature. The merge brings work INTO the branch you stand on: switch back to main first.

hints: git log --oneline shows main's line; the feature branch holds its own commit.
Standing on main, run: git merge feature
